processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Solution treatment at 850 °C for 10 min followed by water quench (as-quenched state, Fig. 9a).

structures.overall_structure: As-quenched microstructure with ferrite showing partial ordering: {111} reflections indicate DO3, {200} reflections could be DO3 or B2, and the intensity difference indicates the initial ferrite is a mix of B2- and DO3-ordered structures; dark-field {200} image is nearly featureless with no resolvable ordered domains.

phases_present.crystal_structure: bcc with partial B2/DO3 ordering (mix of B2- and DO3-ordered structures)

interfaces.phase_evolution: Partitioning between austenite and ferrite leads to a level of Al in ferrite higher than the nominal composition; this partitioning (together with the high Al level) contributes to ferrite ordering (B2/DO3).

characterization_methods.technique: TEM (transmission electron microscopy) with selected area electron diffraction (SAED) and dark-field imaging
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Ferrite oriented in the [011]α ([110]) zone axis; SAED indexed 000, 0–22, 1̄11, 2̄00 and 400 reflections; dark-field image formed with the {200} reflection; scale bar 100 nm.
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe ordered structures (B2/DO3) in ferrite of the as-quenched sample
characterization_methods.key_findings: Extra superlattice spots present; {111} reflections indicate DO3; {200} reflections could correspond to DO3 or B2; intensity difference between {111} and {200} indicates initial ferrite is a mix of B2- and DO3-ordered structures; dark-field {200} image is nearly featureless, finely speckled, with no individual ordered domains resolvable.
